fix.name: Dhruvil
fix.meaning_en: Steadfast, firm; modern Gujarati form built on dhruva (fixed, the pole star) with the suffix -ila

fix.name: Rutvi
fix.meaning_en: Of the seasons; modern name from ṛtu (season), etymology uncertain

fix.name: Rudraneel
fix.meaning_en: Blue Rudra (Shiva); modern Bengali compound of Rudra and nīla

fix.name: Ritwika
fix.meaning_en: Priestess, female priest (from ṛtvij, the officiating priest)
